column1: Register-based labour market statistics – Persons – time series from 2011 to 2021
column2: The Register-based censuses 2011 and 2021 and the annual Register-based labour market statistics (since 2012) are complete surveys on characteristics of the Austrian resident population as per 31 October and are conducted by using information from administrative registers. The characteristics and definitions are based on the EU regulation on population and housing censuses. For further information see (German only): https://www.statistik.at/fileadmin/shared/QM/Standarddokumentationen/B_1/std_b_abgestimmte_erwerbsstatistik.pdf This database contains the results for all persons with a usual residence (resident population). The data from 2021 onwards can be found here: https://statcube.at/statcube/opendatabase?id=deaest_aest_zr_personen .) Territorial structure of 2024. .) Updating: annual update of the territorial structure last update: [2026-06-09] Highest level of education attained 2015 revised, 2011-2014 not revised. .) Contact details: Directorate social statistics For general enquiries: +43 1 711 28-7070 In case of special enquiries please contact registerzaehlung@statistik.gv.at .) Please note: For data privacy protection reasons, the statistical disclosure control method of "record swapping" has been used on a part of the data. For analyses based on very small cell values, no reliable assertions can be made.
Age in completed years at the respective reference date. Calculated from the date of birth.
In order to guarantee protection of data privacy, persons with a third sex category are not separately reported. They are imputed either as "male" or "female".
